questions.question:

Function X(M:integer):integer;

Begin
    i := 0;
    while i*i < M
    do i:= i+1
    X := i
 end

The function call $X(N)$, if $N$ is positive, will return
questions.rawQuestionHtml:

Function X(M:integer):integer;

    i := 0;

 end

The function call $X(N)$, if $N$ is positive, will return

  2. $\lfloor\sqrt N \rfloor +1$
